title: Siren Wail
blurb: A two-and-a-half-second frequency sweep that reads instantly as emergency without belonging to any particular service — which is exactly the point, since it keeps the file safe to use anywhere without impersonating a real siren. Semantically it lands as something is happening and it is probably your fault. Use it for dramatic edits, for prank alarms, or as the soundtrack to somebody announcing a terrible decision in the group chat. Original synthesis, clean, free MP3, no blue lights implied and none legally required.
origin: Original frequency-swept synthesis in the style of a generic emergency siren.
